ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT("Agreement") made as of the31st day of August, 2004 by and between LHL Realty Co., LLC ("Company"), a New York limited liability company, having an office and place of business at c/o Algin Management Co., LLC, 64-35 Yellowstone Boulevard, Forest Hills, Queens 11375 and MCI Realty LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office and place of business at c/o Milton Merl Associates, 601 West 26th Street,NewYork,NY 10001 (the“Adjacent Premises Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Company is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State ofNewYork,known as Lots 5,8,10,11,12,13,43,52,53 and 55 in Block 1152on the Tax Map ofthe City of NewYork, and by the street addresses of229-251West 60thStreet and 218-240 West 61st Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called “Company's Land,”' said buildings and improvements being herein called “Company's Buildings"; and WHEREAS, The Company proposes to improve the Company's Land by demolishing the Company's Buildings and constructing thereon a new building (which new building, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement and applicable law, being herein called the “Company's New Building” and the Company's Land and the Company's New Building being herein collectively called the "Company's Premises"); and WHEREAS,in order to construct the Company's NewBuilding,the Company will apply for: (a) an amendment to the zoning map which is incorporated into the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (the “Zoning Resolution") applicable to the Company's Land and other adjacent parcels of land that, among other things, changes the existing M1-6 zoning district to an R8 zoning district or one ofits commercial district equivalents (the “Company's Rezoning"); (b) a special permit pursuant to Section 74-74 et seq. of the Zoning Resolution to modify certain of the bulk controls in the Zoning Resolution that would otherwise be applicable to the Company's New Building ("GLSD Special Permit"); and (c) a special permit to construct and operate within the Company's New Building a public parking garage ("Parking Special Permit"); and WHEREAS, the Company's Rezoning will also include those parcels of real property which are located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lots 56 and 57 in Block 1152 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by street address, 242-244 West 61st Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Adjacent Land");
